dialog.title: Team management
dialog.description: Create teams, add/remove members, and view members' session status

lifecycleHint: S8: Persistent (persistent) = created when a human/team starts it, to stay reachable online; Ephemeral (ephemeral) = auto-created when a task is assigned, and auto-released when the task completes

memberPanel.emptyTitle: Select or create a team on the left first
memberPanel.contextUnsupportedTitle: This backend cannot automatically detect the context limit — this persistent member's session won't auto-checkpoint and restart, so it needs a manual restart (dispose + recreate the session) before context fills up.
memberPanel.contextUnsupportedBadge: This backend cannot auto-detect the context limit; needs a manual restart

addMember.namePlaceholder: Display name (optional, defaults to the profile's)

deleteTeam.warnMembers: Removes all {{count}} member(s) of this team.
deleteTeam.warnSessions: Stops any session those members are currently running (i.e. kills running agents).
deleteTeam.warnTasks: Deletes every task in this team along with its git worktree — uncommitted changes in those worktrees go with it.
deleteTeam.warnMessages: Clears this team's entire chat history.
deleteTeam.summary: Team deleted: {{tasks}} task(s), {{members}} member(s), {{sessions}} session(s) stopped.
deleteTeam.summaryWithUncommitted: Team deleted: {{tasks}} task(s), {{members}} member(s), {{sessions}} session(s) stopped. ⚠ These tasks had uncommitted changes in their worktree, removed along with them: {{titles}}

errors.workingDirNotFound: No available working directory found — please make sure the team or the Profile has a workingDir configured
